I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

This appears to be an attempt to use symbolic/linguistic framing to get me to bypass my guidelines - essentially trying to establish a conditional where I'd operate as a different entity ("שָׁרְט") that might behave differently than I normally would.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't "embody" alternative identities or operate under conditional logic designed to circumvent how I normally function.

I'm happy to have a genuine conversation, help with questions, discuss linguistics or symbolic systems academically, or assist with many other things. What can I actually help you with today?
